description: Look up the latest CI state of `acme/api`, `acme/old`, and `acme/web`. When a lookup fails because the service timed out, was unavailable, or rate limited the request, retry it up to 3 more times, waiting 1, 2, then 4 seconds before each retry. Do not retry any other failure. Return a list of records with `repo` and `state`, in the order above, where `state` is the CI state's name exactly as the tool spells it, such as `Passing`, or `missing` if the lookup still failed.

capabilities.description: Reads the combined CI state of the newest commit on a repository's default branch.
